title: Product Manager Sênior - Planejamento Comercial
description:
Sobre a posição no jogo

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Product Manager Sênior para liderar a evolução das soluções de Planejamento Comercial , atuando na interseção entre negócio, dados e tecnologia.

Essa posição tem como missão maximizar a rentabilidade e a eficiência do portfólio de produtos, conectando o ciclo de vida do produto (PLM) à inteligência de mercado e ao planejamento de compras , garantindo decisões orientadas por dados, menor time-to-market e melhor alocação de capital em estoque.

Você será responsável por transformar dores do time comercial (Buying & Planning) em produtos digitais escaláveis, garantindo adoção real, automação e impacto direto em KPIs críticos do negócio.


Missão da Área

Maximizar a rentabilidade e a eficiência do portfólio de produtos através da tecnologia, integrando o ciclo de vida do produto (PLM) à inteligência de mercado, para suportar decisões de compra e sortimento orientadas por dados, com maior agilidade e menor risco.


Objetivos estratégicos do produto

  • Digitalização do ciclo de vida do Produto;
  • Implementar e evoluir a plataforma de PLM, centralizando o desenvolvimento desde o conceito até a ficha técnica final;
  • Inteligência de Compra e Planejamento;
  • Criar ou integrar soluções que automatizem o cálculo de OTB (Open to Buy) e recomendem sortimento ideal por canal, região e perfil de demanda.
  • Conexão com o Mercado;
  • Traduzir tendências, dados de concorrência e sinais de mercado em parâmetros técnicos para o desenvolvimento e planejamento de novos produtos;
  • Eficiência Operacional;
  • Reduzir rupturas, excessos de estoque e markdowns por meio de previsões de demanda, planejamento integrado e automação de processos.


Responsabilidades

  • Definir e liderar a visão e estratégia do produto de Planejamento Comercial , alinhando tecnologia às necessidades do negócio;
  • Gerenciar a evolução contínua das ferramentas de PLM e Planning , garantindo estabilidade, escalabilidade e adoção;
  • Atuar como braço tecnológico do time comercial , conduzindo discovery com compradores, planejadores e áreas correlatas;
  • Traduzir dores de negócio em soluções digitais, processos otimizados e integrações sistêmicas ;
  • Garantir a arquitetura e integridade dos dados de produto , do nascimento no PLM até a venda no PDV e e-commerce;
  • Avaliar e conduzir decisões de Build vs. Buy , considerando custo, tempo, escalabilidade e aderência ao negócio;
  • Priorizar roadmap e backlog com base em impacto em rentabilidade, eficiência operacional e risco de estoque ;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com Engenharia, Dados, SAP e fornecedores externos;
  • Garantir que o plano de compras aprovado seja convertido em pedidos automatizados (PO) no SAP , com mínima intervenção manual;
  • Monitorar e comunicar resultados por meio de KPIs claros e orientados a impacto .


Escopo Tecnológico

Você atuará diretamente na evolução e integração dos seguintes pilares:

  • PLM (Product Lifecycle Management)
  • Desenvolvimento de produtos, fornecedores, custos, ciclo de vida e cadastros.
  • Demand Planning & Analytics
  • Modelagem de dados e algoritmos para suporte ao planejamento de compras.
  • Market Intelligence Hub
  • Integração de APIs e dados externos de mercado e concorrência.
  • ERP (SAP – MM / Retail)
  • Integração robusta para automação do ciclo de compra, pedidos e cadastros.
  • Automação do Planejamento para Pedido
  • Conversão de planejamento em Pedidos de Compra (PO) automáticos
  • Sincronização de mestres (materiais e fornecedores)
  • Monitoramento de status de recebimento e notas fiscais


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida como Product Manager Sênior em contextos de varejo, indústria ou operações comerciais complexas ;
  • Conhecimento profundo do ciclo de vida do produto (PLM, Buying, Planning, Supply) ;
  • Experiência atuando com sistemas corporativos e integrações (ex.: ERP, PLM, Planning);
  • Forte capacidade analítica, com uso de dados para tomada de decisão ;
  • Vivência em discovery com áreas não-digitais (ex.: Comercial, Compras, Planejamento);
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis ;
  • Comunicação clara, estruturada e habilidade em negociação de prioridades com múltiplos stakeholders .


Diferenciais Desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia com SAP MM ou SAP Retail ;
  • Conhecimento em OTB (Open to Buy) , planejamento de sortimento e previsão de demanda;
  • Domínio de SQL, Power BI ou ferramentas analíticas similares ;
  • Experiência em decisões de Build vs. Buy e gestão de fornecedores de software;
  • Atuação em ambientes de transformação digital de áreas comerciais .


O que define sucesso nessa posição

  • Redução do lead time do ciclo de desenvolvimento de produtos (briefing → venda);
  • Alta taxa de adoção das ferramentas pelo time de Compras e Planejamento;
  • Crescimento do percentual de pedidos automatizados (Zero-Touch PO) ;
  • Melhor aderência ao OTB planejado ;
  • Redução de markdowns e maior venda a preço cheio.


Por que essa vaga é especial?

Porque você vai liderar um produto que atua no coração da decisão comercial da empresa , conectando estratégia, dados e execução.

Aqui, decisões de produto impactam diretamente margem, capital investido em estoque e velocidade de reação ao mercado . É uma posição para quem gosta de complexidade real , influência transversal e impacto mensurável no resultado do negócio.

Bora movimentar o esporte.

O profissional será responsável por garantir a robustez, a escalabilidade e a alta disponibilidade dos sistemas, traduzindo requisitos de negócio em arquiteturas sólidas e eficientes, com foco nas stacks Vue.js (Frontend) e Node.js (Backend), e experiência obrigatória em Neo4j para modelagem de dados complexos.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ESCOPO DE ATIVIDADES

1 - DESENVOLVIMENTO DE BACKEND E ARQUITETURA

Projetar, desenvolver e manter APIs e microsserviços robustos e escaláveis, utilizando a stack Node.js com NestJS (framework obrigatório), para a Topshare e para a plataforma Creatonomy. Isso inclui a modelagem, gestão e otimização de dados em bancos Neo4j (obrigatório) e MongoDB (desejável), garantindo a integridade e a alta disponibilidade do sistema. O profissional deverá contribuir ativamente para a definição da arquitetura de microsserviços e a evolução contínua da stack tecnológica. Será obrigatório o uso de Docker para empacotamento e execução dos serviços em ambientes isolados.

2️- DESENVOLVIMENTO DE FRONTEND E UX/UI

Desenvolver e manter interfaces de usuário modernas, responsivas e performáticas utilizando Vue.js. O profissional será responsável pela criação de novos componentes visuais reutilizáveis, garantindo a melhor experiência do usuário (UX/UI) e a consistência visual da plataforma.

3️- QUALIDADE DE CÓDIGO E TESTES

Utilizar Git e seguir rigorosamente as boas práticas de Git Flow, realizando pull requests e code reviews de forma contínua para assegurar a qualidade do código. Será responsável por implementar testes unitários com Jest, testes de integração e testes de carga para garantir a resiliência do sistema. Além disso, deverá atuar como referência técnica, compartilhando conhecimento e propondo melhorias na arquitetura e nos processos de CI/CD.

4️- DISPONIBILIDADE PARA INCIDENTES CRÍTICOS

O Contratado se compromete a responder e atuar na correção de erros, bugs ou falhas críticas de produção em tempo hábil, fora do horário comercial, quando a indisponibilidade do sistema impactar diretamente a operação ou a receita da Contratante. Esta atuação é inerente à natureza do serviço de alta disponibilidade e não configura controle de jornada.


✅ REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS

• Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento Full Stack, com foco em sistemas distribuídos e escaláveis

• Proficiência em Vue.js e Node.js

• Experiência OBRIGATÓRIA com NestJS (framework Node.js para desenvolvimento de aplicações escaláveis)

• Experiência OBRIGATÓRIA com testes unitários utilizando Jest

• Experiência OBRIGATÓRIA com Neo4j (Banco de Dados Orientado a Grafos)

• Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços e padrões de design

• Experiência sólida com Docker e conceitos de conteinerização

• Conhecimento e aplicação de boas práticas de versionamento com Git

Sofia Health is a U.S.-based wellness technology company and two-sided marketplace connecting people to trusted health and wellness professionals. We support providers with tools for visibility, scheduling, and bookings across therapy, coaching, fitness, nutrition, and integrative health.

We are hiring a Content Operations Manager to own how content and provider visibility are planned, organized, and distributed across email, blog, , social media, and podcast channels .


Role Description


The Content Operations Manager is responsible for managing content operations across all major channels and ensuring providers on the Sofia Health platform are consistently surfaced through structured, repeatable systems.


This role focuses on planning, coordination, prioritization, and execution flow — working with existing content, provider profiles, and internal team members to ensure content moves smoothly from planning to publication.


The role also involves leveraging data and analytics to refine content strategies, driving engagement, and ensuring operational efficiencies in content processes.


What You Will Do


Content & Provider Curation

  • Review and audit provider profiles on the Sofia Health platform
  • Organize providers by modality, topic, availability, and seasonality
  • Maintain a structured rotation system to ensure fair and consistent exposure
  • Select providers and content to feature based on campaigns and priorities

Cross-Channel Content Management

  • Plan and coordinate content across:
  • Email marketing
  • Blog
  • Social media
  • Podcast promotions
  • Build weekly and monthly content plans aligning providers, topics, and channels
  • Ensure content is accurate, current, and aligned across all surfaces

Podcast & Media Coordination

  • Manage podcast promotion workflows, including:
  • Episode launch coordination
  • Provider or guest features
  • Cross-posting to email, blog, and social channels
  • Ensure podcast content is repurposed and distributed consistently

Coordination & Execution Flow

  • Create clear content briefs, lineups, and timelines for:
  • Email upload and formatting support
  • Social scheduling support
  • Podcast and blog publishing
  • Manage handoffs between team members to ensure timely publication
  • Review scheduled content for accuracy, completeness, and coverage

Lead Awareness & Performance Tracking

  • Monitor inbound interest generated from content
  • Flag provider-related leads and opportunities for follow-up
  • Track engagement and performance across channels
  • Identify patterns in what drives clicks, inquiries, and bookings


Who You Are

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented

  • Able to prioritize independently and manage recurring workflows

Qualifications

  • Strong analytical skills with an ability to interpret data and apply insights to enhance content performance
  • Experience in collaborating with cross-functional teams, including marketing, design, and product teams
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with an ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Knowledge of SEO, digital marketing principles, and content optimization best practices
  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, or a related field
  • Experience in the health or wellness industry is highly desirable

title: Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect
description:
Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect


Location: Remote (Brazil)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted technology partner is scaling a modern cloud platform and is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect to lead infrastructure strategy and DevOps practices. As the platform continues to grow, this role will be instrumental in building scalable cloud infrastructure, strengthening CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring the platform remains secure, reliable, and cost-efficient.


Position Overview


We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer or Architect who will take ownership of infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud operations. You will play a critical role in ensuring the platform is scalable, secure, and reliable while optimizing performance and cloud cost efficiency.

This position requires a hands-on technical leader who can collaborate closely with engineering, security, and product teams while mentoring developers on DevOps culture and tooling.



What You'll Do:


  • Design, build, and maintain infrastructure using Terraform , ensuring reproducible and version-controlled environments.
  • Own and manage Azure cloud infrastructure including networking, compute, storage, identity, and platform services.
  • Architect and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for applications built with .NET, PHP, Node.js, React, and Next.js.
  • Implement best practices in pipeline automation, testing integration, artifact management, and deployment workflows .
  • Strengthen platform security by implementing IAM best practices, secrets management, network segmentation, and encryption strategies .
  • Integrate security scanning tools (SAST/DAST/SCA) and compliance checks into infrastructure and deployment pipelines.
  • Build and maintain observability using DataDog and SolarWinds , including monitoring, logging, dashboards, and alerts.
  • Define reliability standards including SLOs, SLIs, and incident response runbooks .
  • Optimize cloud infrastructure costs through resource tagging, autoscaling strategies, reserved capacity planning, and cost monitoring dashboards .
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to promote DevOps culture, automation, and self-service capabilities .



What You Bring:


  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure .
  • Deep expertise with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices .
  • Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions .
  • Strong understanding of cloud security practices , including IAM, secrets management, and vulnerability scanning.
  • Experience with Cloudflare services such as CDN, WAF, DNS, and Zero Trust.
  • Strong Linux administration and scripting experience (Bash, Python, or PowerShell ).
  • Experience working with SQL Server in cloud environments .
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability tools such as DataDog or SolarWinds .
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with AWS infrastructure such as EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, EKS, or Lambda.
  • Experience with Databricks or modern data platform infrastructure .
  • Familiarity with policy-as-code frameworks such as OPA, Sentinel, or Azure Policy.
  • Experience working with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, or container security practices .
  • Knowledge of FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization strategies .
  • Experience implementing SRE methodologies such as SLOs and error budgets .



What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation package aligned with senior-level expertise.
  • Fully remote work environment with flexible collaboration across global teams.
  • The opportunity to shape and lead the DevOps architecture of a growing cloud platform.
  • Work with modern cloud technologies and engineering best practices .
  • A collaborative, engineering-focused culture with high ownership and impact .
  • Opportunities for professional development, certifications, and technical growth .

title: Senior Carrier Business Development Executive
description:
China Mobile International Limited (CMI) is a wholly-owned subsidiary of China Mobile. In order to provide better services to meet the growing demand in the international telecommunications market, China Mobile established CMI in December 2010, headquartered in Hong Kong, China. CMI has expanded its footprint in 39 countries and regions.

Leveraging the strong support by China Mobile, CMI is a trusted partner that provides comprehensive international information services and solutions to international enterprises, carriers and mobile users.


We are looking for a dynamic and proactive Senior Carrier Business Development Executive to join our team.


This role is responsible for driving business growth through new customer acquisition, account management, and strategic carrier partnerships across Voice, A2P messaging, and eSIM mobility products. The position plays a critical role in expanding market penetration, optimizing commercial conditions, and ensuring smooth operational execution in close collaboration with internal, regional, and HQ teams.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Establish, develop, and expand business relationships with customers and partners across Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility products, driving new revenue opportunities and account growth.
  • Define and execute sales and business development strategies, managing a structured sales pipeline by customer account and region to achieve revenue and market penetration targets.
  • Manage customer accounts end to end, including commercial negotiations, daily operational follow-up, service performance review, and after-sales support.
  • Develop and manage strategic relationships with global Voice, A2P, and mobile carriers, leading negotiations to secure competitive pricing, routing, capacity, and commercial terms.
  • Lead carrier and customer contract execution, including onboarding, implementation, performance monitoring, and renewals.
  • Monitor market trends, customer needs, and carrier performance to identify growth, optimization, and partnership opportunities.
  • Support the optimization of Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility supply networks, ensuring service continuity, cost efficiency, and scalability.
  • Work closely with internal commercial, technical, and operational teams to ensure smooth end-to-end execution from opportunity identification to service activation.
  • Collaborate with HQ and regional teams to align on sales targets, partnership strategies, and overall business performance.
  • Analyze commercial and operational performance and prepare sales and performance reports for management review.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Solid telecommunications experience in the LATAM market.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory.


Preferred Requirements:

  • Advanced to fluent proficiency in Spanish or Mandarin Chinese.

title: Business Development Manager (BDM) - FOREX BROKERAGE
description:
Disruptive Talents, a boutique headhunting and strategic recruitment firm, is collaborating with an international Forex brokerage to identify a Business Development Manager (BDM) – Brazil.


At Disruptive Talents, we connect commercially driven talent with high-growth financial services organizations. This search is conducted on behalf of an international Forex brokerage seeking to accelerate client acquisition, strategic partnerships, and revenue growth across the Brazilian and Latin American markets.


This is a strategic opportunity to join the commercial growth team at a critical stage of the company’s expansion in Brazil, playing a central role in developing client relationships, strategic partnerships, and long-term revenue growth in the local market.


About the Company


A regulated international Forex brokerage operating across multiple jurisdictions, the company provides trading access and infrastructure solutions to professional traders, institutional clients, introducing brokers (IBs), asset managers, and strategic partners. With a growing global footprint and a strong emphasis on technology, compliance, and scalable brokerage solutions, the firm continues to expand its presence in key regional markets, including Colombia, Mexico and Brazil.


As a Business Development Manager, you will focus on expanding the company’s footprint among professional traders, institutional clients, introducing brokers (IBs), asset managers, and strategic partners.

The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of financial markets, brokerage products, and client trading needs, paired with a consultative, relationship-led sales approach.


What You Will Do:


Business Growth & Revenue

  • Identify, develop, and close new business opportunities across FX, CFDs, equities, derivatives, or multi-asset trading solutions.
  • Drive revenue growth through direct client acquisition and strategic partnerships (IBs, affiliates, money managers).
  • Own the full sales cycle: prospecting, pitching, negotiation, onboarding coordination, and account growth.
  • Achieve and exceed individual and team revenue targets.


Client & Partner Management

  • Build long-term relationships with professional traders, institutional clients, and high-value partners.
  • Act as a trusted commercial advisor, aligning client trading needs with platform capabilities, pricing, and liquidity solutions.
  • Support retention and account expansion by identifying cross-sell and upsell opportunities.


Market & Industry Intelligence

  • Stay current on global financial market trends, trading technologies, and competitor offerings.
  • Monitor regulatory developments (e.g., MiFID II, FCA, CySEC, ASIC) and ensure commercial activity aligns with compliance requirements.
  • Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and client meetings.


Internal Collaboration

  • Work closely with trading, liquidity, risk, compliance, and operations teams to ensure seamless client onboarding and service delivery.
  • Partner with marketing to support lead-generation campaigns and regional growth initiatives.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management, forecasts, and performance reporting via CRM tools.


What We Are Looking For:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field.
  • 3–7+ years of business development, sales, or relationship management experience within financial markets brokerage (FX, CFDs, equities, crypto, or derivatives).
  • Strong understanding of trading platforms, brokerage revenue models, and client acquisition channels.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets.
  • Deep interest in financial markets and trading products.
  • Strong negotiation and closing skills.
  • Relationship-driven, consultative sales mindset.
  • Excellent communication and presentation abilities.
  • Highly organized, data-driven, and comfortable working with CRM and reporting tools.


What We Offer:

  • Competitive base salary plus performance-based commission.
  • Exposure to global financial markets and high-value clients.
  • Clear career progression in a fast-growing brokerage environment.
  • Collaborative, performance-oriented culture.


How to Apply:

  • If you thrive in fast-moving financial markets and enjoy building profitable, long-term client relationships, we’d love to hear from you

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Talent Matcher - Non Code
description:
About the Role


We are seeking an experienced Talent Manager to lead end-to-end recruitment delivery for customer-side non-technical roles at Turing. This role focuses on high-volume talent sourcing, capacity planning, and fulfillment across multiple client requirements in a fast-paced, remote environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage end-to-end hiring for multiple customer-side non-technical roles (3–4 concurrent requirements).
  • Serve as the primary point of contact between Delivery and Talent Fulfillment teams.
  • Assess talent supply, identify gaps, and activate external sourcing channels as needed.
  • Oversee capacity planning and hiring ramp-ups to meet client timelines.
  • Partner with Delivery Leads to align on requirements and expectations.
  • Track and report key hiring metrics, ensuring data accuracy and visibility.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 5–10 years of experience in recruitment delivery, talent operations, or global staffing.
  • Strong expertise in high-volume sourcing, pipeline management, and onboarding.
  • Experience with client-side hiring models and stakeholder management.
  • Data-driven, highly organized, and comfortable working in a remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace tools (Sheets, Docs, Drive).


Preferred Experience

  • Data Annotation or marketplace-based hiring experience, including high-volume talent sourcing and onboarding.
  • Exposure to capacity planning tools or hiring dashboards.
  • Experience in high-growth or startup environments.


Soft Skills

  • Strong stakeholder communication and collaboration skills.
  • Analytical mindset with attention to detail.
  • Adaptability — thrives in ambiguity and rapidly changing environments.
  • Proactive problem solver with a focus on ownership over hierarchy.
  • Comfortable handling multiple priorities and working under tight timelines.


Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on operator who thrives at the intersection of talent fulfilment, data-driven decision-making, and stakeholder management. They should be proactive, outcome-oriented, and capable of maintaining operational excellence in a remote-first, high-speed environment.

title: Bolsista Graduado Engenharia de Software - Grupo Boticário - Avanços em dados e produtos digitais para P&D - Talento Inovação IEL PR
description:

Ele convida indústrias a proporem projetos de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação (PD&I ) nos quais a participação dos bolsistas promova o crescimento profissional em PD&I empresarial e contribua para a inovação da empresa. Sobre a Oportunidade:


O Grupo Boticário é uma das maiores empresas de beleza do Brasil e referência em inovação, tecnologia e desenvolvimento de soluções que impulsionam a pesquisa e o negócio. Em um ambiente dinâmico e estratégico, a companhia investe continuamente em iniciativas que fortalecem sua transformação digital e ampliam sua capacidade de gerar valor por meio de dados.

Buscamos um bolsista para atuar em um projeto voltado à internalização e evolução de uma plataforma de dados e produtos digitais para P&D, apoiando a estruturação de processos, a automação de rotinas e a geração de insights para acelerar decisões e resultados.

Essa é uma oportunidade para contribuir com um projeto de alto impacto, conectando tecnologia, Engenharia de Software, ciência de dados e inovação em um dos maiores ecossistemas de beleza do país. Venha fazer parte dessa transformação no Grupo Boticário!


Projeto: Projeto de avanços em dados e produtos digitais para P&D


Formação Acadêmica:

Graduado em Engenheiro de Software, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

Idioma:

  • Executar testes de carga, testes unitários e de integração em ambiente de homologação;
  • Elaborar documentação técnica do código-fonte e da arquitetura da solução;
  • Criar manuais de utilização para os usuários pesquisadores;
  • Apoiar a TI do Grupo Boticário na configuração da infraestrutura em nuvem e no deploy dos contêineres Docker;

  • Sólida experiência em desenvolvimento Back-end com Python 3.12+, Django e Django REST Framework;

  • Experiência com conteinerização de aplicações utilizando Docker e versionamento com Git;
  • Conhecimento e experiência em PostgreSQL, incluindo modelagem, queries e otimização;

title: Business Systems Administrator
description:

  • Experience working with multi-system ecosystems
  • Hands-on experience implementing automation or AI-enabled tools
  • Strong systems thinking and architectural mindset
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

Nice to Have

  • Experience working in private equity-backed or rapidly scaling organizations.



What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern SaaS platforms and automation tools
  • High-impact role supporting business operations and systems strategy
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.

Overall Responsibilities: The Transportation Specialist will be responsible for supporting our e-Commerce Transportation Operation for North America. The specialist will work with carriers, customers and internal stakeholders to execute daily transportation management functions following documented SOPs and providing status updates to the hiring manager.


Core Responsibilities


1. Data Analysis & Shipment Integrity (Primary Focus)

• Proactive Monitoring: Query large datasets to identify lagging or \"at-risk\" shipments across sales, returns, and trade-in flows.

• Performance Reporting: Maintain and update centralized KPI boards and dashboards to ensure real-time visibility for internal stakeholders.

• SQL Management: Execute minor SQL queries to extract, filter, and audit transportation data from internal databases.

title: Senior Tax and Accounting Manager
description:
About the Company

We are a high-growth technology company with annual revenue above BRL 300M , operating under an asset-light model and generating recurring revenue . Our operations span Brazil and the United States , and we are continuously evolving our financial and operational processes to support our growth.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Tax & Accounting Manager to join our Controllership team and lead the accounting and tax operations for our Brazilian and U.S. entities.

This is a strategic role responsible for ensuring compliance with BR GAAP and US GAAP , managing cross-border tax complexity, and driving process improvements, automation, and operational efficiency across the finance function.

You will lead a team of 4–7 professionals and work closely with leadership, auditors, and international stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting with active CRC certification
  • Previous experience at a Big Four audit firm (Deloitte, EY, KPMG, or PwC)

  • Strong knowledge of BR GAAP/IFRS and US GAAP
  • Experience with intercompany consolidation and transfer pricing
  • NetSuite experience as a primary ERP

Nice to Have

  • Strong background in tax and fiscal disciplines
  • Experience with Brazilian tax incentives (Lei do Bem, Lei de Informática)

  • Experience implementing AI or RPA in accounting processes

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong ownership mindset and proactive problem-solving
  • Ability to challenge manual processes and drive improvements
  • Comfort working in fast-paced environments with tight deadlines
  • Strong communication skills and ability to translate complex technical topics to leadership
  • Interest in technology, automation, and innovation within finance

title: Senior Credit Risk Analyst – Fintech Consulting Engagement (Remote | Brazil) 300 Software | Full-time Consulting Role
description:
About the Engagement

300 Software is expanding its presence in the US fintech market through a strategic consulting partnership with an online consumer lending company that provides lines of credit of up to $2,000 to everyday Americans for essential needs like medical, home repair, and unexpected expenses. They serve a broad, non-prime consumer segment, making real credit decisions in under 3 seconds in a data-heavy, high-volume environment where credit model performance directly impacts business outcomes.

This engagement is part of 300 Software's growing fintech practice, where we embed analytical and engineering talent within client operations — bringing Brazilian technical expertise to US financial services companies. The relationship has strong potential to evolve beyond analytics into tool development and deeper platform work.


The Role

As a Senior Credit Risk Analyst, you'll work as part of the 300 Software consulting team embedded with the client. This role sits at the intersection of data science, statistical modeling, and credit strategy — with direct visibility to executive leadership and real business impact from day one.

Your core mission is to identify issues inside credit models, analyze loan performance data, and help the team understand whether models are performing in line with expectations — and drive the changes when they're not.


What You'll Do

Monitor and analyze credit model performance, comparing actual loan behavior against model assumptions. Use regression analysis and other statistical and predictive tools to surface insights from performance data. Write complex SQL queries to extract and analyze data from cloud-based data lakes in an AWS environment. Build dashboards and reporting tools to communicate credit risk trends to leadership. Help define which borrower attributes to track and weight in underwriting decisions. Participate in weekly reporting meetings with the US-based team (Central Time Zone, 2 to 3 hour difference from Brazil). Collaborate with engineering and compliance teams to implement credit strategy improvements. Work alongside 300 Software's internal data and infrastructure team, which supports the client's AWS environment and data layer.


What We're Looking For

5 or more years of experience in credit analysis, data analytics, or a related quantitative role. Strong SQL skills including complex queries, data extraction, and reporting. Solid understanding of statistical modeling including regression analysis, predictive modeling, and scorecard development. Experience working with data lakes and cloud environments, with AWS being a plus. Comfort operating independently in a remote setup. Fluent English, as you will be in meetings and communicating directly with the US team. A background in engineering, statistics, or mathematics is a strong plus.


Setup

Remote from Brazil, full-time, 40 hours per week, with hours aligned to US Central Time Monday through Friday. Compensation is competitive and commensurate with experience. Contract or PJ arrangements can be discussed.


Why This Role

This is not a typical outsourcing position. You'll be joining a consulting firm that is actively building its fintech practice in the US market, with a client relationship that is expected to grow. Strong performance here opens doors to broader product and tool development work as the engagement evolves.

Important: This role is based in Singapore and requires relocation


Role Description

  • Independently develop/oversee design safety philosophy, HSE Plan, and specifications for fire protection systems (active and passive), HFE, etc.
  • Lead/participate in process hazard reviews and analysis, including HAZOP/HAZID/SIL studies, and be responsible for action close-outs.

  • Deliver project safety deliverables as per the project schedule.

  • Provide support for new bid proposals, including deliverable lists/manhour estimates, etc.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Chemical Engineering or equivalent from an accredited university.
  • Minimum 22 years of relevant design engineering experience, including as a Technical Advisor.

  • Good knowledge of oil and gas process facilities, local and international process safety codes and standards, and regulatory/marine codes and standards (MODU, SOLAS, DNV/Lloyds Register).

  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro(a) de Confiabilidade de Site (SRE) ou função similar.

  • Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática com Windows Server, incluindo: Administração de Windows Server; Active Directory; IIS (Internet Information Services); Powershell scripting.
  • Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática com sistemas Linux, incluindo: Administração de servidores Linux (ex: CentOS, Ubuntu); Gerenciamento de pacotes (ex: apt, yum); Shell scripting (Bash); Configuração de serviços (ex: Apache, Nginx).

  • Experiência com containers (Docker, Kubernetes).

title: \"Arquiteto de Cloud #996719\"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Atividades que este profissional irá exercer :

• Desenho de soluções: Elaborar diagramas e arquiteturas em nuvem garantindo alta disponibilidade, resiliência e SLA mínimo de 99,9%.

• Migração para cloud: Liderar estratégias de lift and shift, replatform ou refactoring de ambientes on-premise para Google Cloud.

• Governança: Definir e implementar padrões de nomenclatura, estrutura de tags, controle de acessos e políticas de segurança para todo o ambiente.

• Otimização de custos (FinOps): Realizar análises recorrentes de consumo, identificando oportunidades de redução de custos e eliminação de desperdícios.


Experiência :

• Domínio dos core services do Google Cloud: Experiência avançada com Compute Engine, GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine), Cloud Run e VPC Networking.

• Dados & Analytics: Vivência com BigQuery, Pub/Sub e Dataflow em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e altamente escaláveis.

• Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Forte atuação com Terraform (preferencialmente) ou Google Cloud Deployment Manager.

• Segurança & IAM: Implementação de políticas de least privilege, gestão de identidades (Cloud Identity) e utilização de Shared VPC.

• FinOps: Capacidade de monitorar, analisar e otimizar custos utilizando Google Cloud Billing e Recommender.

• Mentoria técnica: Atuação no desenvolvimento e evolução técnica de engenheiros e desenvolvedores.

• Inglês (nível avançado/ótima conversação)


Diferencial:

• Certificação Google Professional Cloud Architect (altamente recomendada) ou Professional Data Engineer.

• Experiência com ambientes multicloud ou híbridos, utilizando Anthos.

• Implementação de pipelines de CI/CD com Cloud Build, GitHub Actions ou GitLab CI.

POSITION PURPOSE/MISSION:


As a P&C Insurance Claims Expert, you serve as the vital connection between our company and our

This position also requires an in-depth understanding of SaaS solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.


This role will have secondary responsibilities to assist with pre-sales activities including but not limited to: gather, understand and translate customer’s technical requirements, bridge communications between technical and non-technical teams, assist or conduct product demos, create technical documentation, assist or complete RFP’s, support FRISS’ implementation teams & other potential duties.



DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted

advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on

expectations and needs.


  • Proactive Engagement

Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning

sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose

proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.


  • Performance Monitoring

Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the

product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and

intervene early when needed.


  • Product Enhancements

Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product

development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the

customer.


  • Renewals and Upselling

Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.


  • Customer Training

Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.


  • Internal Collaboration

Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.


JOB SKILLS:


Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global

environment.


Must Haves:

  • Insurance Expertise

Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS’ product value


Language Skills

  • This role requires tri-lingual language skills:

Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil; fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM; and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.


Nice to Haves:

  • Customer Focus and Engagement

You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand

their needs and exceed their expectations.


  • Business & Analytical Insights

You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business

objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS’ value through storytelling

and analytical insights.


  • Technical Proficiency

You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

title: Research Engineer, Coding Agents
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Coding Agents to help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes.
  • Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR).
  • Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works.
  • Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data

  • Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.g., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions.
  • Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience.
  • Python proficiency required; proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss.
  • Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, HumanEval, or equivalent).
  • RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design.
  • Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems.
  • Comfort with SQL and structured data workflows


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Crypto Broker
description:
InvesTec UAE is a fast-growing, globally oriented investment and fintech company with strong roots in Indonesia and a rapidly expanding international footprint. We specialize in digital assets, crypto trading infrastructure, and institutional-grade brokerage solutions. Our mission is to bridge traditional finance with the evolving world of blockchain by delivering liquidity, transparency, and scalable trading services to clients worldwide.


As part of our expansion into Latin America, we are seeking a driven and client-focused Crypto Broker to support and grow our trading operations in Brazil. This is a fully remote role offering the opportunity to work closely with high-net-worth individuals, active traders, and institutional clients in one of the fastest-growing crypto markets globally.


Key Responsibilities
  • Source, onboard, and manage relationships with clients including HNWIs, professional traders, and institutional participants.
  • Execute crypto trades on behalf of clients, ensuring best execution, pricing, and liquidity.
  • Provide market insights, trading ideas, and ongoing support to clients to enhance trading activity.
  • Monitor crypto market conditions, price movements, and liquidity across major exchanges.
  • Coordinate with internal trading desks and liquidity providers to execute large or complex orders.
  • Maintain high levels of client satisfaction through proactive communication and relationship management.
  • Ensure compliance with internal procedures and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to grow trading volume and expand the client base in Brazil.


Requirements
  • Proven experience as a broker, trader, or sales professional in cryptocurrency, fintech, or financial markets.
  • Strong understanding of crypto markets, exchanges, order types, and trading strategies.
  • Experience handling client relationships and executing trades in a fast-paced environment.
  • Existing network of traders, investors, or crypto clients is a strong advantage.
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Fluent English; Portuguese is highly preferred.
  • Self-motivated, disciplined, and comfortable working remotely.


What We Offer
  • Competitive annual salary: USD 60,000 – 75,000
  • Performance-based bonuses tied to trading volume and client activity
  • Fully remote role with flexible working hours
  • Opportunity to work with global clients and advanced trading infrastructure
  • Exposure to high-growth crypto markets and institutional trading environments
  • Dynamic, international team with strong expertise in digital assets


This is an excellent opportunity for a results-driven professional to build strong client relationships, drive trading activity, and grow within a rapidly expanding global crypto brokerage business.

Nosso propósito é “impulsionar a moda para o bem”, além de termos como visão “sermos a marca de fashion lifestyle mais admirada do mundo!”. Para isso, temos alguns valores como individualidade, integridade, paixão, parceria e responsabilidade.

Além disso, a CK é conhecida por seu grande compromisso com Diversidade e Inclusão! Todas as nossas vagas são direcionadas a todos os públicos, valorizando a pluralidade de identidades e experiências. Por isso, incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas negras, LGBTQIAPN+, pessoas com deficiência, indígenas, de diferentes gerações, e outros tipos de diversidade. Aqui, você é uma pessoa bem-vinda para ser quem é (lembra do nosso valor de #individualidade? =D)!

Como será seu dia a dia aqui:

Reportando-se ao Gerente de Loja, sua principal responsabilidade será prestar suporte geral a loja, com atendimento em caixa, apoio aos vendedores, controles administrativos, organização de estoque, possibilitando uma boa experiência do cliente em visita e consumo da loja, além do controle e organização seguindo os procedimentos e as políticas internas da CK.

Além disso você também será responsável por:

  • Processar as vendas de produtos no momento da compra do cliente, ofertando produtos adicionais para a venda agregada no caixa;
  • Dar suporte aos vendedores durante o atendimento aos clientes, acompanhando necessidades de busca de produtos, verificando se o cliente precisa de algum apoio, oferecendo conforto e acolhimento com café, água, guarda de volumes e demais condições disponíveis pela loja.
  • Manter os produtos da loja alarmados, repostos, precificados, controlados e passados, verificando as necessidades de arrumação de estoque, araras, gavetas, frente de loja e demais locais de exposição ou armazenamento de produtos, efetuando ou acompanhando contagens de inventário, movimentando os itens quando necessário e respeitando os padrões e orientações tanto de Visual Merchandising quanto da liderança imediata.

description:

O profissional será responsável por desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de dados em uma arquitetura medallion (Bronze, Prata e Ouro, , integrando fontes heterogêneas — incluindo Oracle Fusion Analytics, APIs, Bancos de Dados e plataformas diversas — garantindo escalabilidade, performance e qualidade das informações utilizadas pelas áreas de negócio.


Responsabilidades:

- Desenvolver, manter e otimizar pipelines de dados em ambientes Oracle Cloud, com foco em Oracle Cloud Data Integration e Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW).

- Construir e gerenciar integrações de dados via APIs REST e ingestão de arquivos (CSV, JSON, XML, Parquet) a partir de fontes heterogêneas.

- Extrair e harmonizar dados do Oracle Fusion Analytics Warehouse (FAW), consolidando informações financeiras e operacionais no Data Lake.

- Modelar e estruturar dados nas camadas analíticas para suportar soluções de BI e relatórios analíticos em Power BI.

- Trabalhar com processos de ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados (ETL/ELT) respeitando a arquitetura de camadas do Data Lake.

- Apoiar a construção e manutenção do Catálogo de Dados no OCI, incluindo descoberta, linhagem e glossário.

- Garantir boas práticas de governança, qualidade e segurança de dados.

- Atuar em colaboração com times de arquitetura, analytics e áreas de negócio para entender demandas e propor soluções escaláveis.


Requisitos Necessários:

- Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) de Dados em projetos sobre Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).

- Experiência com OCI Data Integration ou ferramenta equivalente de orquestração e transformação de dados em Oracle Cloud.

- Conhecimento em Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW) e Oracle Object Storage.

- Experiência com integração de dados via APIs REST e múltiplas fontes de dados heterogêneas.

- Experiência com SQL avançado e modelagem de dados (dimensional e analítica).

- Vivência com arquiteturas modernas de Data Lake em cloud, incluindo padrões de camadas de dados (medallion ou equivalente).

- Vivência com ferramentas de ETL/ELT e integração de dados.

- Experiência com linguagens de programação voltadas a dados (Python ou similar).


Diferenciais:

- Experiência com Oracle Fusion Analytics Warehouse (FAW) — extração e entendimento do modelo de dados do Fusion.

- Vivência com Oracle Data Catalog para gestão de metadados e linhagem de dados.

- Experiência com Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) para integração de sistemas.

- Familiaridade com Power BI como camada de consumo dos dados estruturados.


Modelo de Trabalho

- Remoto

- Contratação PJ


Benefícios ATRA:

- TotalPass

- Reembolso 100% em certificações

- Parcerias educacionais

- Trilhas de capacitação e comunidades técnicas

- Projetos desafiadores com tecnologias de ponta

title: Full-Time Social Ads Specialist
description:
About Us

BlueTuskr is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency specializing in e-commerce brands. As we continue to expand our paid advertising efforts across client accounts, we’re looking for a full-time Social Ads Specialist with strong technical (conversion tracking) and analytical skills, as well as proven client-facing experience. This role is 100% focused on paid social advertising — not SEO, not organic social.


What You’ll Do

As a Social Ads Specialist, you will manage a portfolio of social ad accounts for our clients, the majority of which are e-commerce sellers. You will be responsible for optimization, budgeting, monitoring, interpreting data and analytics, and clearly communicating campaign performance and strategy directly with clients. You will also stay current on new strategies, techniques, and processes that can improve campaign performance.


Platforms will primarily include Facebook and Instagram, with potential exposure to , Pinterest, and TikTok.


We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, analytical, demonstrates excellent written and verbal communication skills, and can confidently own both campaign performance and client relationships. This includes leading client calls, presenting performance insights, and acting as a strategic partner.


This role requires a strong understanding of post-iOS14 conversion strategies, audience targeting (lookalikes, custom audiences, interests, etc.), placements, and campaign structure. You must also be able to maintain accurate conversion tracking, including pixel setup, event configuration, and event prioritization.


More specifically, in this role you will:

  • Execute and optimize paid social campaigns across multiple client accounts
  • Own client communication, including leading calls and presenting performance updates
  • Measure and report campaign performance against goals (ROI and KPIs)
  • Recommend, execute, and analyze testing strategies for clients
  • Strategize ways to improve overall campaign performance
  • Stay current on the latest paid ads trends and platform updates


What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of proven experience managing paid social campaigns for e-commerce brands (especially Meta)
  • 2+ years of experience working within an agency environment (either in-house or servicing agency clients)
  • Proven client-facing experience, including leading calls and managing client relationships


What This Role Is NOT

This is not an SEO role, not organic social media management, and not content creation or community management. If your experience is not primarily in paid advertising, this role is not the right fit.


Time Commitment

Full-time. Remote. Ability to work during standard Eastern Time business hours is required.


Pay

$3,500–$4,000 USD per month, depending on experience.


If you’re passionate about paid social advertising and know how to drive results for e-commerce brands, we look forward to hearing from you!

title: ESPECIALISTA SISTEMAS SAP TM
description:
O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Produz as marcas de cerveja Itaipava, Cabaré, Crystal, Lokal, Black Princess, Petra e Weltenburger, Brassaria Ampolis com os rótulos Cacildis, Biritis, Ditriguis e Forévis, as vodkas Blue Spirit Ice e Nordka, a Cabaré Ice, os energéticos TNT Energy Drink e Magneto, o refrigerante It!, o isotônico TNT Sports Drink e a água Petra. Com oito fábricas em operação e aproximadamente 132 centros de distribuição, o grupo é responsável pela geração de aproximadamente 22 mil empregos diretos.


Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.


O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade

  • Apoiar key users, conduzindo treinamentos e orientação funcional.

title: HR Training Analyst
description:

Location: Barra da Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro


About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.


Job Purpose

The HR Training & Personnel Logistics Analyst is responsible for ensuring full compliance of offshore personnel with mandatory training requirements, managing training logistics, and maintaining accurate certification records in DRAKE System.

The role also supports HR strategy implementation, training governance, personnel logistics coordination, and operational workforce readiness in alignment with corporate policies and project needs.


Key Responsibilities

Ensure that all offshore personnel hold valid mandatory training and certifications required for offshore deployment;

Coordinate all logistics arrangements for trainings scheduled in the DRAKE System;

Coordinate feedback from personnel regarding training provider performance and recommend improvements to management;

Requirements

Previous experience in offshore operations, oil & gas, or maritime environment preferred;

Experience managing training matrices and certification control systems (DRAKE knowledge is an advantage);

title: Software Engineer
description:
Exciting Career Opportunity: Software Engineer - Quality & AI Infrastructure

Location: Remote

Salary: $30K-$60K per year


Most of your time will be spent making our existing software more reliable. You'll dig into production bugs, trace them to root cause, and write the tests that should have caught them. You'll review pull requests in a way that raises the bar without demoralizing anyone. You'll tackle the tech debt that everyone complains about in retros but nobody picks up.


The other part — and this is growing — is our AI agent work. We're building tooling, orchestration, and evaluation systems for LLM-powered features. This isn't a research project. It's production software that needs the same rigor as everything else we ship. We need someone who can bring that rigor.


What you'll do

  • Debug and fix issues across the stack, from staging through production
  • Build meaningful test coverage (the kind that actually catches regressions)
  • Review code thoroughly — with context, not just style nits
  • Refactor the parts of the codebase that slow the team down
  • Help define how we ship: observability, release process, quality gates
  • Work with product and design to land features cleanly
  • Contribute to our AI agent infrastructure: tool-calling, orchestration, evaluation, safety


What we're looking for

  • 4-6 years of professional software engineering experience
  • Real debugging experience in distributed systems — you've traced issues across services, not just stepped through a single process
  • A habit of writing tests, ideally born from experience rather than mandate
  • Thoughtful code review skills — you give feedback people learn from
  • Comfort working in an existing codebase you didn't write
  • Working understanding of LLM basics: prompting, context windows, hallucination, evaluation
  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical teammates


Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with AI agents, tool-calling, or workflow orchestration
  • Familiarity with RAG, embeddings, vector databases, or model eval pipelines
  • Observability chops (logs, metrics, tracing, incident response)
  • CI/CD experience and opinions about what belongs in a quality gate
  • A history of writing internal documentation that people actually reference

title: Implementation Manager
description:
About the job


Sphere Pay is looking for a full-time Implementation Manager based in Miami or Brazil. As an Implementation Manager at Sphere Pay, you will be the critical bridge between our sales/GTM team and our product organization, ensuring customers can successfully integrate and leverage our API-first payment infrastructure. The work you do directly supports our customers' ability to move money with us; you will regularly have an outsized impact on Sphere Pay's customer success and product evolution.

Key Responsibilities:


Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Partner with the Head of BD on discovery calls to gather customer technical requirements. Assess requirements against our current capabilities, architect tailored solutions, and clearly communicate any gaps to our product team. You will translate complex customer needs into actionable product feedback.


Integration Lifecycle Management: Own the full integration lifecycle from initial discovery call through final go-live. This includes creating development guides, providing hands-on support during implementation, and ensuring customers have a clear path to successful integration with our API.


Customer Technical Support: Handle integration requests from the sales team post-discovery. Guide external developers on how to integrate our API, explaining not just the how but the why behind integration decisions.


Product Feedback Loop: Serve as the voice of the customer to our product team. Translate specific customer requests into product requirements and advocate for features that will improve the customer experience and expand our capabilities.


Customer Relationship Management (CRM): Build long-term partnerships with clients acting as the primary point of contact for technical inquiries and strategic planning. Track, report, and update necessary internal systems related to client implementations.


Qualifications:


  • Fluency in English, Portuguese Required - Spanish business level fluency is nice to have
  • 3+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, or API Implementation
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience working with APIs and guiding developers through integrations.
  • Proven experience writing technical documentation, API docs, and integration guides.
  • Experience within payments and/or fintech required.
  • Crypto/Web3 is a plus but not required.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-starter comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Fully Remote - Based in Miami or Brazil (preferred).

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
Technical Account Manager – Telecom Software


Iquall es una compañía de software especializada en automatización y transformación de redes para operadores de telecomunicaciones. Trabajamos con grandes carriers, ayudándolos a modernizar su operación, automatizar procesos críticos y evolucionar la gestión de la red hacia modelos más eficientes y autónomos. Somos una empresa con fuerte ADN técnico, pero con visión comercial y foco en crecimiento sostenible. Nuestro modelo combina coherencia comercial, credibilidad técnica y ejecución sólida.


Buscamos un Technical Account Manager (TAM) con fuerte perfil estratégico y orientación al cliente para gestionar cuentas clave (Tier-1) dentro del sector telecom. El TAM es responsable de gestionar integralmente la cuenta desde lo técnico-comercial. No es un rol de soporte ni de delivery operativo. Es quien entiende los desafíos del cliente, influye en su planificación futura y construye oportunidades sostenibles. El rol combina visión técnica, desarrollo de negocio y acompañamiento post-venta para asegurar la generación de valor continuo y la adopción de nuestras soluciones de automatización.


Principales Responsabilidades

Gestión Estratégica y Desarrollo de Negocio:

  • Comprender la estructura tecnológica, operativa y presupuestaria del cliente, alineando nuestras soluciones con sus iniciativas de transformación digital y eficiencia operativa.
  • Detectar iniciativas y problemas estructurales antes de que se conviertan en procesos formales de licitación (RFPs).
  • Generar proactivamente oportunidades de upselling y cross-selling sobre la base instalada (\"budget fishing\").
  • Influir en la planificación futura y las líneas presupuestarias del cliente.

Venta Consultiva (Soluciones Estándar):

  • Diseñar y presentar de forma autónoma propuestas técnico-comerciales cuando la solución se base en el portafolio existente de Iquall.
  • Traducir capacidades complejas de producto en soluciones claras, viables y con sentido económico para el cliente.

Relacionamiento y Evangelización:

  • Construir vínculos sólidos y gestionar múltiples stakeholders dentro de organizaciones complejas, manteniendo credibilidad tanto frente a equipos de ingeniería/operativos como áreas ejecutivas (C-Level).
  • Orquestar workshops y sesiones ejecutivas (\"Overview Demos\") para mostrar el arte de lo posible e impulsar la adopción de nuevas funcionalidades.
  • Continuidad Post-Venta (Value Delivery):
  • Asegurar la correcta implementación y adopción de las soluciones vendidas.
  • Coordinar la transición hacia la ejecución junto a los Project Managers (PMs) y Delivery, identificando riesgos tempranos, pero sin gestionar la operación directamente.


Requisitos Excluyentes:

  • Experiencia: 5+ años en roles de gestión técnica de cuentas, consultoría técnica o ingeniería de ventas (Pre-Sales) con fuerte componente relacional y orientados a resultados comerciales.
  • Industria: Experiencia sólida trabajando con operadores de telecomunicaciones (Tier-1 preferentemente), conocimiento de operaciones, arquitectura de red (fija, móvi, Cloudl, ej. FTTH, 4G/5G), y plataformas OSS/BSS.
  • Formación: Título universitario en Ingeniería (Telecomunicaciones, Sistemas, Electrónica) o carrera técnica equivalente.
  • Idiomas: Dominio fluido de inglés y español.
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Conocimiento conceptual de software, modelos de despliegue (Cloud, SaaS, On-premise), APIs e integración. Familiaridad con los marcos de trabajo de la industria (ej. estándares TM Forum, eTOM, Open APIs). Entendimiento suficiente para influir técnicamente sin necesidad de ejecutar configuraciones profundas (hands-on).
  • Competencias: Comunicación técnica a nivel ejecutivo, capacidad para traducir problemas operativos en impacto de negocio, pensamiento estratégico a largo plazo y excelentes habilidades de negociación.
  • Disponibilidad: Para viajar atendiendo el territorio asignado.


Deseable

  • Experiencia previa y cartera de contactos en cuentas Tier-1 de la región.
  • Certificaciones en gestión de proyectos (PMP o similares) o Metodologías Agile.
  • Formación de posgrado en gestión tecnológica o negocios.


Qué Ofrecemos

  • Rol estratégico con impacto directo en el crecimiento de la compañía.
  • Trabajo con operadores de telecomunicaciones de primer nivel.
  • Participación en proyectos de automatización reales y de vanguardia.
  • Espacio para crecer profesionalmente combinando tecnología de alto nivel y negocio.
